A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the $\eta -\eta'$ photoproduction can be a powerful tool to study the strange component of neutral current couplings, and that the $\eta^\prime$, being an isospin singlet, is a good tool to disentangle the strange and non-strange neutral current couplings.

the $\eta$-$\etap$ coherent photoproduction on the proton can be used to determine the strange component of neutral current coupling $g_{\eta\eta^\prime NN}$.
